data.name: Paging
Query_Get_MaxId
data.value: SELECT IsNull(max(BankFacilityID), 0) + 1 as BankFacilityID FROM Set_BankFacility WHERE [CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [PeriodID] = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_SelectAll
data.value: SELECT * FROM [Set_BankFacility] WHERE [Status] = 1 AND ([IsActive] = @IsActive OR @IsActive is null) AND ([CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_SelectAll_WithPaging
data.value: SELECT [CompanyID], [PeriodID], [BankFacilityID], [BankFacilityName], [BankRefrence], [LimitID], [LimitName], [BankID], [BankName], [Amount], [StartDate], [EndDate], [Status], [IsActive], [CreatedBy], [CreateDate], [CreatedByValue], [UpdatedBy], [UpdateDate], [UpdatedByValue], [AccountNo], [LoanTypeID], [LoanType], [Funded], [NonFunded], [MarkupID], [Markup], [PledgeQty], [PledgeAmount], [GracePeriod], [BusinessPartnerID], [BusinessPartnerName], ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by BankFacilityID, CompanyID, PeriodID) as 'Row' FROM [Set_BankFacility]

data.name: Query_GetBankFacilityDetail
data.value:
select Set_BankFacility.LimitName, Set_BankFacility.LoanType, Set_BankFacility.Amount as Limt, Markup ,Set_BankFacilityDetail.InterestRate ,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ,(SUM((Case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end)) - SUM((Case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end))) as POutstanding from Set_BankFacility left join Set_BankFacilityDetail on Set_BankFacilityDetail.BankFacilityHeaderID = Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankFacility.CompanyID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankFacility.PeriodID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID and AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 left join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID = @FiscalID left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID where Set_BankFacility.Status = 1 and Set_BankFacility.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_BankFacility.PeriodID = @PeriodID
and isnull(Set_BankFacility.BusinessPartnerID,0) = 0 and Set_BankFacility.StartDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate group by Set_BankFacility.LimitName,Set_BankFacility.LoanType,Set_BankFacility.Amount ,Set_BankFacility.Markup,Set_BankFacilityDetail.InterestRate,AR_SET_Bank.BankName ​ union all ​ select Set_BankFacility.LimitName, Set_BankFacility.LoanType, Set_BankFacility.Amount as Limt, Markup ,Set_BankFacilityDetail.InterestRate ,Set_BankFacility.BusinessPartnerName ,(SUM((Case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end)) - SUM((Case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end))) as POutstanding from Set_BankFacility left join Set_BankFacilityDetail on Set_BankFacilityDetail.BankFacilityHeaderID = Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankFacility.CompanyID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankFacility.PeriodID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.Status = 1 ​ left join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = Set_BankFacility.BankID and AR_SET_BankBranch.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_Bank on AR_SET_Bank.BankID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankID and AR_SET_Bank.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.BankBranchID = AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID and AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 left join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BankAccount.PaymentCCID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID = @FiscalID left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @FiscalID where Set_BankFacility.Status = 1 and Set_BankFacility.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Set_BankFacility.PeriodID = @PeriodID and Set_BankFacility.BusinessPartnerID > 0 and Set_BankFacility.StartDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate group by Set_BankFacility.LimitName,Set_BankFacility.LoanType,Set_BankFacility.Amount ,Set_BankFacility.Markup,Set_BankFacilityDetail.InterestRate,Set_BankFacility.BusinessPartnerName
